blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Looped Transformers reuse one block of layers several times: by spending extra computation they push a model of fixed size further, and so use its parameters more fully; while sparse mixture-of-experts (MoE) models activate only a few of many experts for each token. Looped MoE bridges these two design philosophies and gives MoE models new potential for better expert usage, but it raises a question: how to loop a MoE? We answer it with Foil. With the expert parameters and the expert compute per token held fixed, Foil (1) flattens the experts, halving the expert layers, doubling the experts per layer and doubling the passes, so that every routing decision chooses from a larger pool, and (2) unties the attention, giving each pass its own attention parameters while the experts and routers stay shared. Experiments show that Foil clearly outperforms the unflattened looped baseline: at 20B tokens every Foil model has lower pretraining loss than the baseline; at 100B tokens the loss improves monotonically with the degree of flattening, the most flattened Foil ending 0.012 nat below the baseline at equal parameters and compute, with downstream accuracy on par or better; untying the attention also yields more balanced and more confident routing at equal shape. Our ablations analyse why Foil works and turn the findings into design guidance for looped MoE: the returns of looping and of widening the expert layers amplify each other, routing confidence tracks healthy expert use better than load balance, and a sparse looped MoE should therefore use more experts per layer and more passes. Code and configurations are available at https://github.com/SR-A-W/how-to-loop-moe .

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Looped models apply one block of Transformer layers repeatedly to an evolving hidden state, so that the depth of computation is set by the number of passes rather than by the number of stored layers ( Dehghani et al., 2019 ) . A model of fixed size can thus be made stronger by computing more, which uses its parameters more fully: both theory and experiments show that looped Transformers suit computations that need many iterative steps ( Giannou et al., 2023 ; Saunshi et al., 2025 ) , and looping has recently been scaled to large pretraining runs and to spending more computation at inference time ( Geiping et al., 2025 ; Zhu et al., 2025 ) . As hardware compute grows far faster than memory capacity and bandwidth ( Gholami et al., 2024 ) , trading computation for stored parameters is increasingly attractive, and how best to loop a model has become an active question ( Prairie et al., 2026 ; Huang et al., 2026 ) .
blocks.zh: 循环模型将变形金刚层的一个块反复应用到一个不断发展的隐藏状态,从而使计算深度由通过数而不是存储层数设定(Dehghani等人,2019年). 因此,通过更多的计算可以使固定大小的模型更强大,它更充分地使用其参数:理论和实验都表明,循环变形器适用于需要许多迭代步骤的计算(Giannou等人,2023年;Saunshi等人,2025年),而循环最近被放大为大型预训运行,并在推论时间花费更多的计算(Geiping等人,2025年;Zhu等人,2025年)。 由于硬件计算比内存容量和带宽(Gholami等人,2024年)长得多,存储参数的交易计算越来越有吸引力,如何最好地循环一个模型成为一个活跃的问题(Prairie等人,2026年;Huang等人,2026年).

blocks.en:
Sparse mixture-of-experts (MoE) models take a different route to efficiency: each layer holds many experts, but every token is routed to only a few of them, so that the parameter count far exceeds the computation per token; current large models hold hundreds of experts per layer and route each token to only a few ( DeepSeek-AI, 2024 ; Kimi Team, 2025 ) .
The price is that a token sees only k k experts in each layer, and the more experts there are, the less often each of them is used. Whether the experts are actually used, and whether they specialise, has been a central question since the first sparse MoE models ( Fedus et al., 2022 ; Zoph et al., 2022 ) , and a balanced load alone does not answer it ( Li et al., 2026 ) .
blocks.zh:
Sparse 混合型专家(MoE)模型在效率上采取了不同的路线:每层都持有许多专家,但每个符号只有几个符号,因此参数计数远远超过每个符号的计算;目前的大型模型每层持有数百位专家,每个符号只有几个符号(Deep Seek-AI,2024;Kimi Team,2025).
其代价是,一个标志只看到每层的kk专家,而专家越多,使用每层专家的次数就越少. 专家是否实际使用,是否专业,自第一批零星的MOE模型(Fedus等人,2022年;Zoph等人,2022年)以来,一直是一个中心问题,单靠平衡负载并不能回答(Li等人,2026年).

blocks.en: These two design philosophies are, however, naturally compatible. A routing decision exposes a token to only a few of the available experts; looping changes this: every pass gives the token a new routing decision in the same layer, so it can reach different experts, and different combinations of them, without storing any additional expert parameters. Our measurements make this potential concrete in three observations. (1) Looping brings better performance or fewer parameters. At equal parameters, looping twice lowers the loss by 0.064 0.064 nat, and a looped model with far fewer parameters nearly matches a non-looped model with twice the layers by spending more computation per token ( Figure 1 , top). (2) Looping lets a sparse MoE use more of its experts. The number of distinct experts a token reaches grows with the passes, from 16 16 without looping to 36 36 with eight passes ( Figure 1 , bottom). (3) Looping unlocks equivalent-parameter properties for MoE. Because experts are called repeatedly, the equivalent number of experts and the number of possible routing combinations grow multiplicatively as the looped block is flattened, while the real experts and the compute stay fixed.
blocks.zh: 然而,这两种设计哲学自然是相容的. 路由决定只向少数现有专家暴露一个符号;循环改变这一点:每个路由都给予路由指示在同一层中新的路由决定,这样它就可以到达不同的专家,和不同的组合,而不存储任何额外的专家参数. 我们的测量在3个观察中使这种潜在的混凝土化. (1)循环带来更好的性能或更少的参数. 在等参数下,循环两次将损失降低0.064 0.064纳特,一个参数少得多的循环模型通过花费更多的每令牌计算,几乎匹配一个非螺旋模型和两层的两倍(图1,顶部). (2) 循环让一个稀少的教育部使用更多的专家。 随着通行证的到来,信使获得的专家人数从16人增至36人,其中8人通过(图1,下方)。 (3)循环解锁为MOE提供等效参数属性,由于专家被反复调用,由于循环块被平整,而真正的专家和计算器被固定,专家的等效数量和可能的路由组合的数量会成倍增长.

blocks.en:
Earlier work has combined looping with experts ( Csordás et al., 2024 ; Chen et al., 2026b ; Jaggi, 2026 ; Li et al., 2025 ) , but none has studied how the experts should be distributed over the looped block—how many experts a layer holds, how many layers the block has and how many times it is looped—when the expert parameters and the compute are fixed. Nor has it been asked which parameters a pass should own: with attention shared across passes, flattening discards the attention parameters of the layers it removes, whereas giving each pass its own attention keeps the parameter budget and lets successive passes process the shared experts’ inputs differently, at no extra compute.
This raises our question: how to loop a MoE when its parameters and compute are fixed? We answer it with Foil. Foil (1) flattens the experts, scaling down the number of layers in the looped block while scaling up the experts per layer and the number of passes in proportion, so that every routing decision chooses from a larger pool, and (2) unties the attention, giving each pass its own attention parameters while the experts and routers stay shared across passes. Our contributions are:
blocks.zh:
早先的工作将环绕与专家结合起来(Csordás等人,2024年;Chen等人,2026年b;Jaggi,2026年;Li等人,2025年),但没有人研究过专家应如何在环绕的块上分布——当专家参数和计算固定时,层层有多少,层层有多少,层层多少,环绕多少。 也没有人问过一个通过应拥有哪些参数:在通过之间分享注意力的情况下,平分它去掉的层的注意参数,而通过每个层的注意会保持参数的预算,并让连续的通过以不同方式处理共享专家的投入,而无需额外计算。
这提出了我们的问题:当教育部的参数和计算被固定时,如何循环? 我们用Foil来回答 Foil (1)平整专家,缩小循环区块中的层数,同时按比例扩大每层专家人数和通过人数,使每个路由决定都从更大的池中选择,(2)解开注意力,在专家和路由器保持过关共享的同时,让各自通过自己的关注参数. 我们的贡献是:

blocks.en: Figure 2: Vanilla looped MoE versus Foil . Both models share the same skeleton: a prelude (embedding and one regular MoE layer), a recurrent core applied for several passes, and a coda (one regular MoE layer and the LM head). The vanilla core ties both attention and experts across passes. Foil flattens the core—it keeps the total number of experts fixed while using fewer layers, more experts per layer and more passes—and unties the attention: the experts are shared across passes, but every pass has its own attention set, selected by the pass index. blocks.en: Every model is trained on the same data in the same order, from the same initialisation seed and under the same learning-rate schedule, for 20B tokens (training details in Appendix C ); this is 35–40 tokens per parameter for the eight compared models, enough by the Chinchilla ratio ( Hoffmann et al., 2022 ) , and we scale the main models up to 100B tokens. The router applies a softmax at temperature 1 1 over the experts of a layer and selects the top two, without noise or bias terms.
blocks.zh: 每个模型都按照相同的顺序,从相同的初始化种子和相同的学习率时间表,为20B令牌(附录C中的训练细节);这是8个比较模型的每个参数的35–40令牌,足够按照钦奇拉比(Hoffmann等人,2022年)进行,我们把主要模型放大到100B令牌. 路由器在温度11时将软max应用在一层的专家之上,并选择前二,没有噪音或偏差术语.

blocks.en: Downstream, the main text reports three zero-shot tasks, one representative for each of word prediction (LAMBADA, standard split), sentence continuation (HellaSwag) and coreference resolution (XWinograd, English). We report (1) language-modelling loss at the end of training, compared between models as paired differences with standard errors, (2) downstream task results, and (3) routing metrics ( B 2 B_{2} and MMR). Full results are provided in Appendix D , including a seed-change experiment that supports the robustness of the results.

blocks.en: 3.1 Flattening with more passes raises the ceiling of model ability

blocks.en: Holding the real expert count E real = 64 E_{\mathrm{real}}=64 and the expert calls per token E comp = 32 E_{\mathrm{comp}}=32 fixed, we flatten Base step by step, halving the layers of the recurrent core, doubling the experts per layer and doubling the passes, which gives Foil-3, Foil-2 and Foil-1; every pass keeps its own attention.

blocks.en: Flattening improves the model at both training lengths ( Figure 3 ): • At 20B tokens , all three Foils reach a lower loss than Base. The loss falls through the second flattening step and then levels off: Foil-1 ends 0.007 0.007 nat below Base, slightly above Foil-2. On the three representative tasks, the Foils are at or above Base, within their standard errors. • At 100B tokens , every flattening step lowers the loss and Foil-1 is the strongest, 0.012 0.012 nat below Base. On the three representative tasks, all three Foils score slightly above Base, by one to two standard errors. The 100B results confirm the 20B findings and enlarge them: the gain of the flattest shape grows with training, while Foil-2’s stays put. Further downstream results are in Table 5 . The remaining experiments use 20B tokens.

blocks.en: 4.3 Load balance alone does not indicate healthy specialisation
blocks.zh: 4.3 (中文(简体) ). 负载平衡本身并不表明健康的专业化

blocks.en: Load balance is the classic measure of expert utilisation, but it has been questioned: a balanced load can hide a router that has no preference among the experts, which motivated measuring routing confidence as well ( Li et al., 2026 ) .
blocks.zh: 负载平衡是专家利用的经典衡量标准,但有人对此提出疑问:平衡载荷可以隐藏一个在专家中没有偏爱的路由器,这也促使测量路由信心(Li等人,2026年)。

blocks.en: Along the flattening sequence with untied attention, B 2 B_{2} falls steadily from the unflattened model (Base) to the most flattened one (Foil-1), while MMR rises ( Figure 4 , c1–c2). Following the readings of Section 2.3 , we read these only as trends of each metric, not as absolute comparisons across different E E . Yet the most flattened model reaches a lower loss than the unflattened one ( Figure 3 ): the lower balance does not come with a worse model.

blocks.en: 5 Related Work
blocks.zh: 5 相关工作

blocks.en: Looped models apply the same layers repeatedly to an evolving hidden state, trading computation for depth and reuse for parameters, from the Universal Transformer to latent reasoning and scaling laws for recurrent depth ( Dehghani et al., 2019 ; Giannou et al., 2023 ; Saunshi et al., 2025 ; Geiping et al., 2025 ; Zhu et al., 2025 ; Bae et al., 2025 ; McLeish et al., 2026 ; Schwethelm et al., 2026 ; Prairie et al., 2026 ) . Their looped blocks are dense; ours is a sparse MoE, whose experts and attention must be arranged over layers and passes.
blocks.zh: 循环模型反复将相同的层层应用于不断演变的隐藏状态,将深度计算和参数再利用作为交易,从通用变换器到重复深度的潜在推理和缩放定律(Dehghani等人,2019年;Giannou等人,2023年;Saunshi等人,2025年;Geiping等人,2025年;Zhu等人,2025年;Bae等人,2025年;McLeish等人,2026年;Schwethelm等人,2026年;Prairie等人,2026年)。 他们环绕的街区很密集;我们的教育部很稀少,其专家和注意力必须分层排列,分层排列。

blocks.en: Sparse MoE models activate only a few experts per token and thus grow their parameters far beyond their computation, and they now underlie most large language models ( Fedus et al., 2022 ; Lepikhin et al., 2021 ; Zoph et al., 2022 ; Jiang et al., 2024 ; DeepSeek-AI, 2024 ; Qwen Team, 2025 ; Muennighoff et al., 2025 ; Kimi Team, 2025 ; Kimi Team, 2026 ; GLM-5 Team, 2026 ; MiniMax, 2026 ) ; the granularity of the experts is a further design dimension, splitting experts into smaller ones and activating more of them ( Dai et al., 2024 ; He, 2024 ; Ludziejewski et al., 2024 ) . Earlier work combines looping with experts by turning the layers of a looped Transformer into shared mixtures of experts or by looping a whole MoE block ( Csordás et al., 2024 ; Chen et al., 2026b ) ; MoEUT ablates how many distinct consecutive layers form its repeated group and uses two for its smaller models. Other work ties experts across neighbouring layers ( Jaggi, 2026 ; Tan et al., 2025 ; Chen et al., 2026c ) : MoRE lets adjacent layers share one larger expert pool, each layer keeping its own router ( Qiu et al., 2026 ) , and Megrez2 is similar ( Li et al., 2025 ) . In dense models, One Wide FFN shares one widened feed-forward layer across the encoder layers while keeping per-layer attention ( Pires et al., 2023 ) , a dense counterpart of flattening with untied attention. Each proposes one form of sharing, but none compares, at fixed expert parameters and compute, the layout ( E , D , L ) (E,D,L) of the looped block and whether its attention is shared across passes; Jaggi (2026) and Megrez2 share experts with per-layer attention, as we do, but start from compressing deep models rather than varying the layout of a looped block.
blocks.zh: Sparse MoE模型只激活了每个符号的几个专家,因此其参数远远超出了计算范围,现在它们成为大多数大语言模型的基础(Fedus等人,2022年;Lepikhin等人,2021年;Zoph等人,2022年;Jiang等人,2024年;DeepSeek-AI,2024年;Quen Team,2025年;Muennighoff等人,2025年;Kimi Team,2025年;Kimi Team,2026年;GLM-5 Team,2026年;MiniMax,2026年);专家的颗粒性是另一个设计维度,将专家分成较小的维度,并激活更多的维度(Dai等人,2024年;He,2024年;Ludziejewski等人,2024年)。 早期的工作通过将环状变形器的层层变成专家的共享混合物,或循环整个MOE块(Csordás等人,2024年;Chen等人,2026年b年);MOEUT减少多少个不同的连续层构成其重复组,并用两个来进行其较小的模型. 其他工作关系专家跨越相邻地层(Jaggi,2026年;Tan等人,2025年;Chen等人,2026年c年) :MORE让相邻地层共用一个更大的专家池,每层保存自己的路由器(Quu等人,2026年),Megrez2类似(Li等人,2025年). 在密集模型中,One Wide FFN在保持每层注意力的同时,共享一个跨编码器层的拓宽的向导层(Pires等人,2023年),这是用不附带条件的注意力进行平整的密集对应物. 每一个都提出一种分享形式,但没有一种比对,在固定的专家参数和计算上,循环块的布局(E,D,L)(E,D,L)以及它的注意力是否跨越通道共享;Jaggi(2026)和Megrez2和我们一样,与每个层次的注意力共享专家,但从压缩深层模型开始,而不是改变循环块的布局.

blocks.en: Load balance is usually maintained by auxiliary losses, capacity limits or bias-based balancing without an auxiliary loss ( Fedus et al., 2022 ; Zoph et al., 2022 ; Wang et al., 2024 ) ; beyond imbalance, experts can degrade through representation collapse or a router without preference ( Chi et al., 2022 ; Li et al., 2026 ) , and recent routing and balancing methods build on the same score-distribution and effective-count views ( Shahout et al., 2025 ; Nguyen et al., 2026 ; Wu et al., 2026 ) . We keep a standard balance metric, add MMR, which measures confidence against the median of all experts, and a traffic-matched masking test, and interpret them only through the three readings of Section 2.3 .
blocks.zh: 负载平衡通常通过辅助损失,容量限制或不附带损失的偏差平衡来维持(Fedus等人,2022年;Zoph等人,2022年;Wang等人,2024年),超出不平衡,专家可以通过代表倒闭或无偏倚的路由器而降解(Chi等人,2022年;Li等人,2026年),最近的路由和平衡方法建立在相同的得分分配和有效计数观点(Shahout等人,2025年;Nguyen等人,2026年;Wu等人,2026年)的基础上. 我们保留一个标准平衡度量,增加一个MMR,它用所有专家的中位数来衡量信任度,以及一个流量匹配的遮罩测试,并且只能通过2.3节的三读来解释.

blocks.en: 6 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 6 结论

blocks.en: How should a MoE be looped? We answer with Foil, which flattens the experts into fewer, wider layers looped more often and unties the attention across passes. At equal parameters and compute, Foil outperforms the unflattened looped baseline, its loss improves monotonically with flattening at 100B tokens, and at every shape it beats the attention-sharing proto-Foil in loss, downstream accuracy and, at 20B, routing balance and confidence. Our ablations show that widening and looping amplify each other, that load balance alone does not indicate healthy specialisation while MMR moves with the looping gain, and that its per-pass peak marks where flattening gains least. Limitations and future work are discussed in Appendix J .
blocks.zh: 教育部应该如何循环? 我们用Foil来回答,它把专家们平整成更少,更宽广的层层,更频繁地循环起来,并解开大家的注意力。 在等参数和计算时,Foil优于未平整的循环基线,其损失通过100B令牌的平整而单调改善,在每一种形状上,均在损失,下游精度,以及20B时的径向平衡和信心上击败了注意力分享原型Foil. 我们的模拟显示,相互扩大和循环扩大,负载平衡本身并不表明在MMR随着循环增益而移动时具有健康的专业性,而且其每过关峰值的平坦收益最少。 附录J讨论了限制和今后的工作。

blocks.en: All models are trained on the sample-100BT subset of FineWeb-Edu ( Penedo et al., 2024 ) , tokenised with the SmolLM2 tokenizer ( Ben Allal et al., 2025 ) (vocabulary 49,152 49{,}152 ), which yields 101.7 101.7 B tokens. Sequences are packed to a context length of 4,096 4{,}096 tokens. Every run reads the data in the same fixed order, so that at every optimiser step all runs have seen the same tokens; this makes the step-wise paired comparisons possible.
blocks.zh: 所有型号都接受了FineWeb-Edu(Penedo等人,2024年)的样本-100BT子集的培训,该子集与SmolLM2标致剂(Ben Alal等人,2025年)(vocabulary 49,152 49{,}152)相配,其产值为101.7 101.7 B标致剂. 顺序被打包到上下文长度为4,096 4{,}096令牌. 每次运行都会按照相同的固定顺序读取数据,这样在每一个opimiser步骤中,所有运行都看到了相同的符号;这使得继位配对比较成为可能.

blocks.en: We use AdamW ( Loshchilov and Hutter, 2019 ) with β 1 = 0.9 \beta_{1}=0.9 , β 2 = 0.95 \beta_{2}=0.95 , weight decay 0.1 0.1 and gradient clipping at norm 1.0 1.0 , in bfloat16. The global batch is 96 96 sequences, i.e. 393,216 393{,}216 tokens per step. The learning rate follows a warmup–stable–decay schedule ( Hu et al., 2024 ) : a linear warmup over 1,000 1{,}000 steps to a peak of 3 × 10 − 4 3\times 10^{-4} , a constant phase, and a decay over the last 10 % 10\% of the run with a 1 − ⋅ 1-\sqrt{\cdot} shape down to 5 % 5\% of the peak. All models share this schedule, the initialisation seed ( 42 42 ) and the data order; the seed replicate changes only the initialisation seed, to 43 43 .

Every model adds to the language-modelling loss a load-balancing loss of the Switch Transformer form ( Fedus et al., 2022 ) with coefficient 0.01 0.01 and a router z-loss ( Zoph et al., 2022 ) with coefficient 0.001 0.001 . Both are computed for every MoE layer on every pass and averaged over the unrolled depth. The losses we report are the language-modelling loss alone.

blocks.en:
Final checkpoints are evaluated on 36 downstream tasks. A task is kept as valid only if all 35 models trained for 20B tokens (all widths) score, on average, at least five standard errors above its baseline (chance level, zero for open-ended completion, or the majority class for classification tasks), in the metric and setting that lies furthest above the baseline. The appendix reports seven valid tasks: the three representative tasks of the main text, and PROST, LAMBADA (OpenAI), SWAG and BLiMP.
The three representative tasks of the main text take one task from each of three categories: word prediction (LAMBADA, standard split), sentence continuation (HellaSwag) and coreference resolution (XWinograd, English). Zero-shot is the main setting ( Table 5 ). For 5-shot ( Table 6 ), HellaSwag is averaged over three evaluation seeds, which change the choice of in-context examples; the other tasks have seed 0 only, and BLiMP and LAMBADA (OpenAI) have no 5-shot variant. Standard errors are those of the evaluation harness; a mean over tasks treats the tasks as independent, and the standard error of a difference between two models is se a 2 + se b 2 \sqrt{\mathrm{se}_{a}^{2}+\mathrm{se}_{b}^{2}} , which ignores that both models answer the same questions and is therefore conservative.

blocks.en: Appendix I Expert-masking evaluation
blocks.zh: 专家评估

blocks.en: The masking test asks whether experts that receive little traffic are also of little value. It uses two disjoint samples of the same corpus: sample A selects the experts, sample B measures the loss. On sample A we count, for every physical expert of the recurrent core, how often it is selected into the top- k k , with the passes pooled onto the physical expert; the prelude and coda layers are never masked. Sorting the experts by this share from lowest to highest and adding them until the cumulative share is closest to x % x\% of all routing requests gives the least-used group T ⁡ ( x ) T(x) . Masking sets the routing probabilities of the masked experts to zero before the top- k k selection, so that each token chooses its k k experts among the remaining ones with renormalised weights; nothing is retrained. We report the increase Δ ​ L T \Delta L_{T} of the mean language-modelling loss on sample B, and compare it with 20 random groups drawn from the experts outside T ⁡ ( x ) T(x) and matched to its traffic share (fixed seeds). Every masked set must leave at least k k experts in each layer. We use x = 10 % x=10\% ( Table 12 ).

blocks.en: At the 10% tier, across all 16 combinations of the eight models and the two token budgets, the loss increase from masking the least-used group never falls below the range of the random groups: rarely used experts are not dispensable. On the least flattened models at 20B tokens the least-used group costs more than almost every random group (19 or 20 of 20 for Base-tied, Base and Foil-3; Tables 12 and 13 and Figure 6 ). Low load therefore does not indicate low value, and an unbalanced load is not by itself a sign of an unhealthy router.

blocks.en: Appendix J Limitations
blocks.zh: 附录J 限制

blocks.en: Four limitations bound our conclusions. First, we have no non-looped control at equal parameters and compute: the non-looped model with the expert parameters and expert calls of ( 8 , 8 , 2 ) (8,8,2) is ( 4 , 16 , 1 ) (4,16,1) , which raises the active share k / E k/E to 1 / 2 1/2 and so confounds sharing experts across layers with the sparsity of activation. Our question is how the experts should be arranged within the looped block once looping has been chosen; that sharing experts across layers is itself useful is supported by external evidence ( Qiu et al., 2026 ; Jaggi, 2026 ) . Second, apart from one seed replicate, every model is trained with a single seed; the replicate differs by − 0.0003 ± 0.0009 -0.0003\pm 0.0009 nat, which sets the resolution of our comparisons, every difference interpreted in the main text is at least 0.002 0.002 nat, and the loss standard errors are optimistic because consecutive steps are not independent (Appendix C ). Third, all results are at a single width, d model = 1024 d_{\mathrm{model}}=1024 . Fourth, the ablations use shared attention, under which the gain from flattening vanishes after the first step ( Figure 4 , a1–a2); untying the attention is what lets the gain continue, so the ablation trends may differ in size for Foil itself.
blocks.zh: 我们的结论有四个限制。 首先,我们没有在等参数和计算上的非导电控制:具有专家参数和专家调用(8,8,2)的非导电模型(8,8,2)是(4,16,1) (4,16,1),它把活性共享k/Ek/E提高到1/2,1/2,因此使专家与激活的痉挛分层共享感到困惑. 我们的问题是,一旦选择了循环,应如何将专家安排在循环区块内;跨层共享专家本身是有用的,并得到外部证据的支持(Quu等人,2026年;Jaggi,2026年)。 第二,除了一个种子复制,每个模型都用一个种子来训练;复制的差别是-0.0003±0.0009-0.0003\pm 0.00009纳特,它确定了我们比较的解析度,在正文中解释的每个差异至少是0.0020.002纳特,损失标准误差是乐观的,因为连续步骤不独立(附录C). 第三,所有结果均为单宽,d型=1024 d_{\mathrm{model}}=1024. 第四,浮雕利用了共同的注意力,根据这种注意力,平坦收益在第一步之后消失(图4,a1-a2)。 解开注意力是让收益继续存在的原因,因此,浮油本身的膨胀趋势可能不同。
